text: Every Thursday I nominate the energy we buy for each of the next 28 days, per region. If we are short on a day I buy the gap on the spot market at about three times the contract price. If we are long, I resell the surplus at about half price. What will demand be?
I can take a feeder out for maintenance next week only on a day when its neighbours can carry its load. For feeder F017, how high could daily demand go on each of the next 7 days?
The board decides in March on new transformer capacity for Al-Rimal. How high will the peak summer day be in each of the next three years?
